android_mechanism: Repeated lookup executed per row during import; fix caches the lookup
bug_description: In the playlist page content list, every song row build passes sid/index to SongCard as this.list.indexOf(item), twice per row. indexOf is a linear scan over the whole (potentially 1000+) song list, so rendering/scrolling the playlist costs O(n) per row and O(n^2) cumulative, wasting UI-thread time as the list grows.
fix_summary: The index already provided by the LazyForEach item generator is passed to SongCard, removing both per-row linear scans.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.measured_as: perf_hw-instructions over the search-result render workload (Pura 70 Ultra)
evidence.note: 6.46M vs 2.75M median hw-instructions (2.35x, disjoint ranges); mechanism counter 250500 vs 0 indexOf comparisons per render pass (measurements-staging).

mechanism_oracle.definition: UI-thread CPU time attributable to list-row building during the scroll (from ace trace component-build events), divided by number of rows rendered.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed per-row build time grows linearly with playlist size (indexOf scan) while fixed stays constant; with >= 500 songs, unfixed scroll CPU > fixed by >= 10% and unfixed shows more dropped frames.

reproduction: git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_indexof_in_render/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_indexof_in_render/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
